notes: The article τούς is emptied by rule 20 proper, the genitive αὐτοῦ being present and unspent.

all manner of is read as a supplied frame on πᾶσαν under rule 99's quantifier clause, which names a quantifier carrier explicitly (παντί → all manner of on all); giving manner of to the noun remains conceivable but would leave νόσον two English realizations.
s002's he called unto him and s007's and gave follow rules 7 and 88: the supplied juncture belongs to the finite verb it introduces, not to the participle it follows.
